notes.title: Bug Fix (2019/01/17)
notes.content:
- Fixed a game crashing issue.
- Added an auto-save feature.
Each time you move between maps, the game will automatically save to slot 80 (final slot).
* If you have save data in slot 80 and wish to retain it, please save it to another slot before playing the updated game.
